text.text_excerpt: Really great spot to see the New Orleans Jazz Orchestra. I came here with a friend for a show of NOJO arrangements of Rolling Stones songs. So naturally that was pretty freaking cool in and of itself, and the space nicely contributed to the experience. There's a very sleek bar/lounge area when you first enter, and you walk through a little hallway past the restrooms to get to the concert venue. It's a really beautiful space with great acoustics. Plus, during the show, you can text your order to the bar and they'll bring your drink right to your seat, so you don't have to miss any of the show or bother the patrons around you. After the show, a few members of the band came out to the lounge...

Visited NOJO's Jazz Market for the TedX event. The space is beautiful! Really good flow around the main bar area, easy accessibility to the bar. The theater is well appointed, but smaller than I would have expected. I suppose NOJO wanted to keep it intimate. The acoustics are great...all that you would expect for a musical/concert/theater venue. As this was not a typical event for the market, I'm not sure what their prices will be, nor am I sure if they will sell food. It looks like they had a well stocked bar though, and the bartenders were friendly and knowledgeable. There is a "special viewing" area up the stairs with tables and cocktail service. This is one of my favorite venues in NOLA. Why, you say? Well: 1. Because of the small house size, every seat has a good view. 2. The NOJM's acoustics & design/layout are fantastic. 3. There are some really good shows here (Sheila E & Ledisi are some recent shows that were crazy good). 4. Despite needing to make their money back from a relatively small house size, they still offer affordable tickets for shows (a major plus). 5. I've been told that the Spoken Word Open Mic Night on Wednesdays is worth catching. 6.
